## Activity

North City Eye Clinic recorded 51 captures during August 2019. The activity was completed as part of the clinic’s routine operational work. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. The available activity record indicates that image capture proceeded without any other reported disruption. The total of 51 captures provides the basis for the image quality and grading results reported below.

## Image quality

Of the 51 captures, 2 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 3.9. The ungradable images were excluded from grading. The image quality outcome should be considered alongside the overall capture activity for August 2019. No further image-quality issue is recorded in the available report.

## Grading

There were 2 referable results. The median grading lag was 1. This records the central grading turnaround for the reporting period. The grading results relate to the images available for assessment after the 2 ungradable captures were excluded. Overall, the site completed its planned activity, with the reported grading outcomes and image-quality results documented for review.
